title: Papier's sales swell to $50M this year, fueled by a desire for analog products
claim: Category demand: stationery brand Papier reported sales rising to about $50M on analog demand, with Gen Z a large share of customers. This is evidence for paper planners in general, not for hobbymaxxing products.
